schemas/actions/actions.v1.schema.json.description: Envelope schema for all messages carried on the Deckr actions lane. The messageType value selects the body shape; endpoint addresses, subjects, timestamps, and recipient targeting remain part of the shared message envelope contract.

schemas/hardware/capability-descriptor.v.description: Contract shape for one hardware capability exposed by a control or device. Capability identifiers, family/type/direction, access modes, value schemas, command schemas, and constraints are consumed across language runtimes.

/properties/capabilityId.description: Stable capability identifier scoped to the containing control or device.

/properties/family.description: Namespaced capability family. Enum and family values are case-sensitive contract values.

schemas/hardware/control-descriptor.v1.s.description: Contract shape for a physical or logical control on a hardware device, including geometry and the input/output/state/config capabilities available through that control.

/properties/controlId.description: Stable control identifier scoped to the containing device.

schemas/hardware/device-descriptor.v1.sc.description: Contract shape for a hardware device descriptor. Hardware managers publish these descriptors so controllers and action runtimes can reason about controls, capabilities, sources, and connections without depending on a device-specific implementation.

/properties/deviceId.description: Stable device identifier scoped to the publishing hardware manager.

/properties/fingerprint.description: Optional durable hardware fingerprint used to distinguish a physical device from a reused device id.

schemas/hardware/hardware-messages.v1.sc.description: Envelope schema for all messages carried on the Deckr hardware_messages lane. Hardware managers and controllers use this lane for device availability, control input, capability state, and capability-targeted commands.

schemas/services/services.v1.schema.json.description: Envelope schema for all messages carried on the Deckr services lane. Service endpoints use these messages for endpoint-addressed commands and replies without becoming injected Python objects.

schemas/state/action-provider-catalog.v1.description: Current-state payload advertising the actions available from one configured action provider endpoint and session.

/properties/providerInstanceId.description: Configured action provider endpoint id that owns this catalog.

schemas/state/device-claim.v1.schema.jso.description: Current-state payload representing a controller claim on a device. The claim uses endpoint and session identity rather than process-local runtime ids.

/properties/claimedByEndpoint.description: Controller endpoint address that currently owns the claim.

schemas/state/endpoint-presence.v1.schem.description: Current-state payload advertising that an endpoint session is present on a lane. Presence uses contract endpoint addresses and lane names, not Python runtime component names.

/properties/endpoint.description: Deckr endpoint address with shape '<family>:<endpoint-id>'. Endpoint families and ids are case-sensitive.

/properties/lane.description: Deckr lane name that this endpoint session is present on.

schemas/state/hardware-inventory.v1.sche.description: Current-state payload publishing the devices and descriptors currently owned by one hardware manager endpoint.

/properties/managerId.description: Hardware manager endpoint id whose inventory is represented by this payload.

schemas/state/service-catalog.v1.schema..description: Current-state payload advertising one service endpoint's namespace, supported operations, and view key prefixes.

/properties/serviceId.description: Service endpoint id that owns this catalog.

schemas/state/service-status.v1.schema.j.description: Current-state payload publishing the current availability state and diagnostics for one service endpoint.
